resolution.note: review loads project records from the PR base tip, diff from merge-base; CLI tests: dropped rule still fails, merged rule change inherited

title: standards review judges the PR head against the rules of the PR base
body:
Evidence 2026-11-18 (Astra gap map, .krn/runs/research/daily-2026-11-18/astra-full.md §2 item 6; Claude Code verification article: changes cannot modify their own checks): standards review selects files from the diff but loads records via readProject(root) from the tree under review, so one change can weaken a project rule and violate it at once.
Outcome: a PR review binds its verdict to the base/head pair and judges HEAD content with the records of the actual PR base (any base branch name); after a rule change merges, the next PR inherits it.
Proof: CLI test: on base trunk a rule forbids a pattern; the branch adds the pattern and drops the rule; review exits 1 naming the base rule id; control after a legitimate rule merge passes.
Files: src/brain/standards-review.ts, src/brain/standards-cli.ts, test/brain/standards-review.test.ts
